name: Yield Optimizer USD
oneLiner: yoUSD is an ERC-4626 yield-aggregator on Base that rebalances USDC across 50+ whitelisted DeFi protocols, with NAV appreciating from accrued strategy yield.
collateral: USDC deposits continuously rebalanced across 50+ whitelisted DeFi yield sources on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and Unichain; allocations ranked by Exponential.fi risk-adjusted ratings with per-pool caps (max 50%) and per-protocol caps (max 70%); 5 smart contract audits by Offbeat Security, Hunter Security, Spearbit/Cantina, Aether Labs, and Paladin with no critical or high findings; admin multisig with <4 signers controls protocol whitelisting; backed by Paradigm, Haun Ventures, and Coinbase Ventures
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 vault on Base; USDC deposited via yoGateway, rebalanced cross-chain to whitelisted DeFi pools; NAV appreciates with accrued yield (e.g. ~$1.069 at launch anniversary); instant redemptions up to liquidity buffer, larger withdrawals up to 24h as cross-chain positions unwind

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: yoUSD is issued independently as a local ERC-4626 vault on Base, Ethereum, and Arbitrum. YO's gateway documentation says deposits and redemptions occur independently on each chain and shares received on one chain can only be redeemed there, so no bridge control carries the issuance claim.

reserveReview.rationale: YO documents yoUSD as a USDC-denominated ERC-4626 vault that rebalances across whitelisted DeFi pools using risk-adjusted allocation. The first-party API reports current live pools and allocations that materially differ from the former 39/21/4.5/4.5/8/7/6/10 authored split. Because YO recalculates allocations daily, the reserve is represented as one dynamic strategy envelope rather than another unpinned static snapshot.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: YO protocol documentation and live yoUSD vault-allocation API
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: YO publishes live pool and allocation data, but the strategy set and weights are recalculated daily and cannot be represented as durable authored percentages. Legal custody safeguards also remain unknown.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The first-party API exposes current positions, but YO recalculates allocations daily; fixed venue and asset weights require a pinned snapshot or a live composition adapter.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: YO identifies its vaults and whitelisted DeFi strategy venues but does not establish statutory segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, or provider shares. Rehypothecation is marked permitted because the vault actively deploys deposits into lending and other DeFi strategies.

notices.title: Resolv-linked strategy loss
notices.message: yoUSD reported a roughly 2.95% drawdown after the March 22 2026 Resolv exploit impaired Resolv-linked exposure. Treat the NAV as strategy-risk-bearing, not a monotonic dollar claim. https://resolv.xyz/blog/resolv-postmortem-march-22-2026-incident

mintAuthority.summary: yoUSD is an ERC-4626 vault on Base where users mint shares by depositing USDC. Base USDC issuance is inherited from Circle; the vault's RolesAuthority holds no share-mint capability, leaving strategy execution, redemption fulfilment, pausing and a Safe-proposed 2-day timelock upgrade as the privileged surfaces.

controls.label: yoUSD admin Safe
controls.evidence: Safe API confirmed Base Safe 4-of-6 (threshold 4, 6 owners, no modules, zero guard, fallbackHandler 0xfd07..., version 1.4.1+L2) at Base block 47201583. This Safe holds PROPOSER_ROLE on the 2-day TimelockController (0x38ce5e45d0f5d03e83863bb19b3b1a272c186f48) which owns the ProxyAdmin (0x12e81209d180ff0b3fbfbfe8fa9ffdb5990e1073) that controls the yoUSD vault upgrades.

controls.label: yoUSD authority contract
controls.evidence: Enumerated on-chain 2026-07-20 at Base block 48888171. yoUSD.authority() = this contract, verified on Blockscout as a Solmate RolesAuthority whose owner() is the 4-of-6 admin Safe 0x67b6f699f1c8040414032a3c2c88a54db144fcd2. getRolesWithCapability(vault, selector) is non-zero only for manage(address[],bytes[],uint256[]) (roles 11, 12, 17), fulfillRedeem(address,uint256,uint256) (role 15), pause() and unpause() (roles 13, 14), approve (role 11) and approveToken (roles 12, 102); it returns 0 with isCapabilityPublic = false for deposit(uint256,address), mint(uint256,address), redeem, withdraw, requestRedeem, cancelRedeem, setAuthority, setApprovalRegistry, transferOwnership and every fee setter. The verified YoVaultRename implementation 0x64efce64a41274e2fe87793cc77caa62911b3b13 declares deposit() and mint() as `public override whenNotPaused` with no requiresAuth modifier, while only manage() and fulfillRedeem() carry requiresAuth. This authority layer therefore governs strategy execution, redemption fulfilment and pausing, and holds no capability to create yoUSD shares.

controls.label: yoUSD ERC-4626 vault (share mint on deposit)
controls.evidence: At Base block 48888171 the verified implementation behind this proxy (YoVaultRename 0x64efce64a41274e2fe87793cc77caa62911b3b13) exposes deposit(uint256,address) and mint(uint256,address) as unauthenticated `whenNotPaused` ERC-4626 entrypoints; share creation is deposit-driven at NAV and no privileged mint path exists on the vault.

controls.label: yoUSD ProxyAdmin owner TimelockController
controls.evidence: At Base block 47201583, the vault's EIP-1967 admin was ProxyAdmin 0x12e81209d180ff0b3fbfbfe8fa9ffdb5990e1073 and ProxyAdmin.owner() was this TimelockController. getMinDelay() returned 172800 seconds. An implementation change through that owned ProxyAdmin can alter local share-mint logic.

review.evidence: At Base block 47201583: yoUSD vault (0x0000000f2eB9f69274678c76222B35eEc7588a65) confirmed as TransparentUpgradeableProxy. ProxyAdmin = 0x12e81209d180ff0b3fbfbfe8fa9ffdb5990e1073 (confirmed via EIP-1967 admin slot). ProxyAdmin owner = TimelockController 0x38ce5e45d0f5d03e83863bb19b3b1a272c186f48 with 2-day minDelay (172800 seconds). Admin Safe (0x67b6...) holds PROPOSER_ROLE on the timelock. Safe confirmed 4-of-6, version 1.4.1+L2, no modules, zero guard via Safe API. Authority contract 0x9524e25079b1b04D904865704783A5aA0202d44D was enumerated at Base block 48888171: it is a Solmate RolesAuthority owned by the 4-of-6 Safe, and getRolesWithCapability/isCapabilityPublic return zero for deposit(), mint(), redeem(), withdraw() and every fee or authority setter, while non-zero capability bitmaps exist only for manage(), fulfillRedeem(), pause() and unpause(). The verified implementation source confirms deposit() and mint() carry no requiresAuth modifier. yoUSD share creation is therefore entirely deposit-driven with no privileged mint call; the residual privileged surfaces are strategy execution via manage(), redemption fulfilment, pausing, and implementation replacement through the 2-day TimelockController.
